plain_english_policy: This document outlines the rules for carrying firearms in Alabama, focusing on reinstatement rights after termination due to firearm possession and restrictions on where guns can be carried. It also defines what constitutes a 'deadly weapon' and clarifies that business entities generally have no duty to protect against third-party crimes unless they knew about an imminent threat.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The policy would likely lead to more permissive gun laws in Alabama, allowing individuals with licenses or even those without (in certain contexts) to carry firearms in places like private property and motor vehicles under specific conditions. It also provides legal recourse for those whose rights are violated by such restrictions.
sponsorship_supports_position: The policy is sponsored by individuals or groups advocating for gun ownership and carrying rights, likely including the National Rifle Association (NRA) or similar organizations.
evidence_quotes: "A person who owns or controls private property... may restrict or prohibit as trespassers those who possess or carry firearms"

"Except as otherwise provided in this section, a business entity... may not establish, maintain, or enforce a policy or rule that prohibits or has the effect of prohibiting a person's transportation or storage of a firearm"

"A person or business entity has no duty to guard against the criminal acts of a third party... unless the person or business entity knows or has reason to know that the criminal acts are occurring or are about to occur on the premises"

"For the purposes of this section, 'motor vehicle' shall mean any automobile, truck, minivan, sports utility vehicle, motorcycle, motor scooter, or any other vehicle required to be registered under state law when operated on the highways of this state"
"A person who is denied the opportunity to transport or store a firearm or ammunition by a policy or rule prohibited in subsection (b) may file a civil action..."
"This section shall not apply if any of the following conditions are satisfied: The person operating the motor vehicle is [prohibited from possessing firearms under federal law, court order, etc.]"
"Nothing in this section shall be construed to authorize the carrying or possession of a firearm where prohibited by federal law."
